formatDescription: The MRtrix Tracks File Format stores white matter fiber tractography data. It uses a human-readable text header with key-value pairs starting with mrtrix tracks, ending with an END statement, and followed by raw binary floating-point coordinate data representing streamline vertices.
provenanceCompoundName: Digital Research Alliance of Canada - FRDR / Alliance de recherche numérique du Canada – DFDR
